rv.q: They are, in fact, uniformly superior, and Daniel Sullivan has staged the play with an ungimmicky simplicity that allows each one to shine
However, it’s the performances and not the production that are key to elevating “The Country Girl” above its essence of quality soap, and on that count, Nichols and his cast deliver.
And for whatever reason, everyone in “The Country Girl” seems to be operating on his or her own isolating frequency.
The credible production lacks the histrionics necessary to fire the melodrama.
